name: ═══════════════ SERVER MANAGEMENT TELEGRAM ═══════════════
info:
## Server Management Telegram Integration

**Flow Number:** 12

### Purpose
Provides Telegram bot commands for server management (boot, shutdown, status).

### Commands
- `/boot [dell|hp]` - Boot server via WoL or iLO
- `/shutdown [dell|hp]` - Graceful shutdown
- `/force [dell|hp]` - Force shutdown
- `/status` - Get server status

### Features
- Boot commands (WoL for Dell, iLO for HP)
- Graceful and force shutdown
- Real-time status monitoring
- Automatic status change notifications
- Command execution response notifications

### Dependencies
- telegram_bot_config (shared)
- mqtt_broker_local
- Server flows (10-dell-*, 20-hp-*)

### Integration
Commands are routed from main Telegram interface (50-telegram-interface.json).
